profile.name: Jordan Rivera
summary_options: Business Analytics student and data analyst intern who turns raw operational data into clear reports and dashboards.
Analyst focused on SQL, Python and Power BI, building repeatable reporting that replaces manual spreadsheet work.
Data-minded problem solver who cleans messy datasets and explains the results to non-technical teams.

experiences.title: Data Analyst Intern
experiences.context: Fictional regional shipping company with 12 depots. Intern on the operations reporting team.

bullets.text: Wrote a library of SQL queries that pulled weekly shipment volumes and delays from the operations database, cutting weekly report preparation from about 4 hours to 1 hour.
bullets.impact: 75% less time on the weekly report

bullets.text: Built a Power BI dashboard tracking on-time delivery rate across 12 depots, letting regional managers spot underperforming routes without requesting custom reports.
Cleaned and standardized 18 months of carrier invoice data in Python (pandas), fixing inconsistent date formats and duplicate records before analysis.
bullets.impact: made a year and a half of invoices analyzable

bullets.text: Analyzed late-delivery causes by depot and carrier and presented three recommendations to the operations lead, one of which was adopted for the next quarter.

experiences.title: Retail Sales Forecasting (Python)
experiences.context: Course project forecasting weekly sales for a public sample retail dataset.

bullets.text: Forecast weekly sales for 45 sample stores using time-series regression in Python, comparing three models and selecting the one with the lowest error on held-out weeks.
bullets.impact: chose the most accurate of three models

bullets.text: Engineered holiday and promotion features that improved forecast accuracy over a seasonal baseline, and documented the method in a short report.

experiences.title: Customer Churn Dashboard (Tableau)
experiences.context: Course project on a public sample telecom churn dataset.

bullets.text: Designed a Tableau dashboard showing churn rate by contract type, tenure and service plan, with filters so viewers could compare customer segments.
Used SQL to join customer, billing and support-ticket tables into one analysis view before visualizing it.
bullets.impact: single clean source for the dashboard

bullets.text: Ran weekly inventory counts and reconciled them against the point-of-sale system, flagging mismatches to the store manager.
Helped customers find course materials during peak semester rush while keeping checkout lines moving.
